definition: SR-related CTD-associated factor 4; a gene encoding an RNA polymerase II-interacting factor that is essential for proper polyA site selection during mRNA transcription termination. Heterozygous gene-disrupting or truncating variants in SCAF4 cause Fliedner-Zweier syndrome (OMIM #620511), an autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by mild intellectual disability, speech impairment, behavioral abnormalities, seizures, and skeletal/structural anomalies.

source.title: Variants in SCAF4 cause a neurodevelopmental disorder and are associated with impaired mRNA processing
source.quote: One of these proteins is SR-related CTD-associated factor 4 (SCAF4), which is important for correct usage of polyA sites for mRNA termination.
